inputs.text: Create an original sophisticated minimalist wall-art illustration inspired by traditional East Asian ink painting principles and contemplative natural landscapes. Subject: mountains and a rising sun, with a magnificent muted vermilion sun or moon and elegant layers of mist. Expressive organic black-ink brushstrokes, delicate tonal transitions, subtle handmade-paper texture. Warm ivory background, deep charcoal brushwork, restrained vermilion accents, exceptional visual balance. Refined asymmetry, graceful negative space, calm meditative atmosphere, subtle natural imperfections. Beautiful abstracted silhouettes, soft atmospheric depth, exquisite paper grain, elegant minimalist composition. Timeless decorative fine art suitable for contemporary interiors and coordinated premium printable collections. Original brushwork, original composition, no copying of historical or contemporary artworks, no artist signatures, no calligraphy, no typography, no logos. Portrait orientation, 2:3.
